anatomical_frame_identity_gate.rule: Head must have positive and A1A2 must have negative projection relative to compiled Thorax origin on baseline Thorax local +X; otherwise GEOMETRY_IDENTITY_FAILURE

anatomical_metric.anterior_axis: Thorax local +X transformed to world by baseline Thorax xmat
anatomical_metric.frame: compiled Thorax body frame at the fresh neutral baseline
anatomical_metric.landmark: origin of the named Femur body (the coxa distal child landmark)
anatomical_metric.selection_policy: The same proximal distal-coxa landmark and projection formula are fixed for all six legs before perturbation; no alternative landmark or axis may be selected from results.

classification.rule: Resolve only with valid identities, identical fresh baselines, opposing axis-projected mechanical rotations, finite opposite-signed projected anterior displacements, and each displacement strictly above metric tolerance. Positive projection is anterior.

prohibitions: neural firing or motor survey activity
